terms.comment: The classical net (Lewis & Short), used of a network as Traupman’s interrēte builds on it. Traupman, Morgan–Owens and Levi–Bini have no word for a computer network.

sources: Lewis & Short: rete
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 261, 334, checked against the searchable text of the book (9 November 2026).
Searched in Morgan–Owens (network, wireless network) and Levi–Bini (rete).
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, with its references, in the house spelling (macrons, consonantal j); they have not been checked against a modern edition.
